children.default: What is Workwize for distributed teams?

children.name: text
children.label: Text
children.default:
Workwize is a zero-touch IT hardware lifecycle management platform for remote and hybrid teams.

Thanks to automated workflows and a network of global suppliers and warehouses, IT teams can efficiently procure, deploy, manage, retrieve, and dispose of IT equipment within one platform.

Utilizing SSO integrations with your existing HRIS, MDM, and ticketing systems, Workwize can save each IT team over 40 hours per month.
